title: Mamoul (Eid biscuits)
hookLine: Saudi Arabian-inspired mamoul (eid biscuits) with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix butter with sugar until creamy. Add oil flour and semolina and mix. Add warm milk and don't knead too much. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even. Incorporate {m53221_1}, {m53221_2}, {m53221_3}, and {m53221_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure plain flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fry Until Golden & Crisp
steps.instructionTemplate: Cover and leave aside for an hour or less until you prepare the filling For the dates filling, fry some sesame in a pan then add butter. Add the dates paste and mixed well with sesame and butter. Then add a little bit of water until it's mushy. Be careful don't make it too mushy. Take it of the pan, put in a plate until it's cool. Then start to shape balls that weigh 15 gm. Incorporate {m53221_5} and {m53221_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Refrigerate for 1/2 an hour. Get back to the dough and shape it as balls that weigh 30 gm. Take the date filling out of the fridge and start to stuff each dough ball with dates ball.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Then use the mamoul mould to give it this shape. In a preheated oven 180 degrees, put it for 20 minutes until golden from below and little bit golden from above.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
